reference_boundary: Official OpenAI source docs are citation metadata and governance references only. This manifest defines decision-record fields and gates; it must not select hosted models, enable API-backed runners, user-directory writes, or compatibility defaults.

applies_to: model default changes in docs or config
quality_gates: decision cites a current official model catalog or freshness-gated source
quality KPIs and service SLOs are measurable from logs or eval artifacts
model changes require an eval baseline before and after the change
prompt cache retention, service tier and privacy rationale are recorded when cache-sensitive models are considered
production workflows pin model/runtime assumptions or document why floating is allowed
rollback plan names the previous model, trigger threshold and owner
must_not: use latest/current/default model claims without retrieved_at and expires_at
change production model defaults based on a single informal trial
compare models without comparable prompts, tools and datasets
treat lower cost as acceptable without quality and latency evidence
